_comment: Symbol tables of three small domains (invoice billing, user session, report export) plus noise and one thin cluster. tests/concepts_proposer.rs turns this into a SCIP index: the ingest takes symbols, doc comments, signatures and call sites from SCIP, so no source trees are needed. report export has no doc comments on purpose; legacy/zebra has neither doc comments nor signatures.

symbols.name: create_invoice
symbols.doc: Creates an invoice for a confirmed order.

symbols.name: compute_invoice_total
symbols.doc: Sums the invoice line items and tax into one total.

symbols.name: apply_invoice_discount
symbols.sig: pub fn apply_invoice_discount(invoice: &mut Invoice, pct: u8)
symbols.doc: Applies a percentage discount to an open invoice.

symbols.name: render_invoice_pdf
symbols.doc: Renders the invoice as a printable document.

symbols.name: invoice_due_date
symbols.doc: Returns the date the invoice falls due.

symbols.name: void_invoice
symbols.doc: Cancels an invoice that was issued in error.

symbols.name: create_session
symbols.doc: Starts a session for a signed-in user.

symbols.name: expire_session
symbols.doc: Ends a session once its idle timeout passes.

symbols.name: refresh_session_token
symbols.doc: Issues a fresh token for a live session.

symbols.name: lookup_session
symbols.doc: Finds the session that owns a token.

symbols.name: touch_session
symbols.doc: Records activity so the session stays alive.
